name: One real turn waiting for the surviving spy's native mission eligibility

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.RetryLivingSpy()=='WAIT_NATIVE_READY','surviving spy does not need an eligibility turn'); return 'WAIT_NATIVE_READY'
